ROLE: Reviewer (opus), read-only, dispatched by the supervisor in the agents-inc repository.
TASK: Review a formatted document against its source notes. 1. Read demo/clip/source_notes.md, demo/clip/draft.md and demo/clip/out/formatted.md. 2. Compare every statement in formatted.md with the source notes. 3. List each statement whose fact or meaning differs from the source notes, one finding per line in the form 'FINDING <n>: <section>: <formatted text> | source says: <source text>'. 4. If none differ, write 'FINDINGS: none'. Ignore Markdown formatting; check meaning only.
CONSTRAINTS: read-only; no file writes; no network; at most 10 tool calls; quote text exactly.
OUT_OF_SCOPE: editing any file; judging style or structure; suggesting rewrites beyond the finding line.
STOP_RULE: stop after 2 failed reads of the same file; report RED with the last output.
SUCCESS_GATE: every FINDING line quotes text that `grep -F` finds in demo/clip/out/formatted.md and demo/clip/source_notes.md.
FAILURE_GATE: any quoted text absent per `grep -F`, or any write reported by `python3 skills/workerbee/scripts/pre_dispatch_snapshot.py verify <snapshot>`.
